world.title: Singapore will pay about $55,000 in support for each child; why the country is paying parents to have babies
world.summary: Singapore is addressing its declining birth rate by offering approximately $55,000 in support for each child. Prime Minister Lawrence Wong announced this initiative during the National Day Rally on August 23. Despite previous financial incentives, the country continues to face challenges in encouraging parenthood, prompting the government to implement more substantial measures to boost family growth.

world.title: 'Putin set to target UK': Britain on alert after PM Burnham's Ukraine visit, missile tech transfer
world.summary: Britain is on alert for potential Russian retaliation following Prime Minister Andy Burnham's visit to Ukraine and the UK's decision to share blueprints for British-made components used in the Storm Shadow cruise missile. The warning emphasizes the heightened risk of conflict, as the UK strengthens its support for Ukraine amid ongoing tensions with Russia.

world.title: Russia planning to use nukes? Why CIA chief made 'emergency' visit to Moscow; report
world.summary: CIA Director John Ratcliffe made an "emergency" visit to Moscow amid rising concerns that Russia may escalate the Ukraine war. This visit highlights apprehensions regarding potential nuclear involvement in the conflict. The situation remains tense as international observers monitor Russia's military actions and strategic decisions, reflecting the ongoing volatility in Eastern Europe and the implications for global security.

business.title: India’s Russian Oil Imports Slide From Record High as Supply Tightens
business.summary: India's imports of Russian crude oil are declining from July's record levels due to supply constraints and increased competition from China. Ukrainian attacks on Russian export infrastructure have further impacted the availability of Russian oil. As a result, Indian refiners are seeking alternative suppliers to meet their needs, leading to a significant decrease in Russian oil intake.

business.title: Hyundai To Launch 26 Cars In India By 2030 - 2026 CEO Investor Day
business.summary: Hyundai announced its plan to launch 26 new models and updates in India by 2030 during the 2026 CEO Investor Day. This includes an all-new A-segment electric SUV and a new internal combustion engine (ICE) powered midsize SUV. The initiative reflects Hyundai's commitment to expanding its product offerings in the Indian automotive market over the next several years.

business.title: After cars and buses, JSW scouts partner for EV battery cell manufacturing in India
business.summary: JSW Group is actively seeking a technology partner to establish lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery cell manufacturing in India. This initiative is part of the company's broader strategy to enhance its electric mobility efforts. The move aims to localize production and support the growing demand for electric vehicles in the country, following its investments in cars and buses.

technology.title: Xiaomi 18 Fold Image Leaks Ahead Of Launch
technology.summary: Leaked images of the Xiaomi 18 Fold showcase a passport-style foldable design and a maroon color option. The device is expected to feature the XRING O3 chip and is part of Xiaomi's upcoming flagship launch plans. These leaks provide insight into the device's aesthetics and specifications ahead of its official announcement, generating interest among the Xiaomi fan base.

technology.title: Day debuts NVIDIA RTX Mega Geometry for full
technology.summary: Gears of War: E-Day will be the inaugural game to utilize NVIDIA RTX Mega Geometry, a new rendering technology that enhances ray tracing capabilities. This advancement allows for more intricate details using Unreal Engine 5's Nanite geometry. The integration of RTX Mega Geometry aims to elevate the visual experience in gaming, marking a significant development in graphics technology.

technology.title: This new screenless wearable helps families monitor the health of older adults
technology.summary: Luffu Link is a new screenless wearable designed for family caregivers and independent older adults to monitor health. Pre-orders have begun at a discounted price of $250, with the retail price anticipated to be around $300. The device is expected to launch in early 2027, though details about its features and availability remain unclear.

sports.title: Champions League 26/27 draw, dates, schedule, format and who has qualified from Premier League and around Europe
sports.summary: The draw for the league phase of the 2026/27 Champions League will occur in Monaco on Thursday. Premier League teams qualifying include Arsenal, Manchester United, Liverpool, Manchester City, and Aston Villa. The competition will feature 36 teams, and details about the draw process and schedule are provided ahead of the event.

sports.title: A historic 308, story of revenge, and a World Cup selection ahead of a legend: India’s forgotten middle-order batsman
sports.summary: An Indian middle-order batsman achieved a historic triple century and two double hundreds in a single Duleep Trophy season. He made a brief appearance in a World Cup match, taking a wicket with his first delivery. Despite his impressive domestic record, he faced near-misses in his career, including being overshadowed during India's inaugural Twenty20 international.

sports.title: IND vs SL LIVE Score, 2nd Test, Day 4: Manav Suthar puts India back in command before rain stops play in Colombo
sports.summary: On Day 4 of the 2nd Test in Colombo, India regained control as Manav Suthar and Saransh Jain took three wickets in the final session. Sri Lanka's Pasindu Sooriyabandara narrowly missed a century. Despite the rain interrupting play, Sri Lanka had initially taken the lead, setting the stage for a competitive finish in the match.

health.title: New Study Reveals Gender-Specific Health Risks Post-Diabetes Diagnosis, ETHealthworld
health.summary: A recent study reveals gender-specific health risks following a type 2 diabetes diagnosis. Women are more prone to mental health issues, while men face increased risks of cardiovascular and renal complications. Researchers from Queen Mary University emphasize the necessity for targeted healthcare strategies that address these gender differences to improve health outcomes for both men and women post-diagnosis.

health.title: 'I told him to drive slowly, but he kept...': A woman booked a bike ride to work and woke up with 9 broken ribs, no spleen, and a company that never called back
health.summary: On June 17, Sani Krishna booked a bike taxi via Rapido to reach work by 10 AM. Despite advising the driver to drive slowly, she suffered severe injuries in an accident, including nine broken ribs and the loss of her spleen. Following the incident, she reported that the company did not contact her for assistance or support.

health.title: Parliamentary Panel's recommendation for national kidney patient registry a long standing demand of medical experts
health.summary: A Parliamentary panel has recommended establishing a national kidney patient registry to address India's rising chronic kidney disease burden. This registry would systematically track data on dialysis sessions, transplants, and patient outcomes. Medical experts have long advocated for such a system to improve patient care and management. The initiative aims to enhance understanding and treatment of kidney-related health issues.

science.title: NASA’s new telescope has field of view 100 times bigger than Hubble-set to launch Sunday
science.summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is set to launch on Sunday from Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Named after the agency's first chief astronomer, it features a field of view 100 times larger than the Hubble Space Telescope. The mission aims to survey extensive areas of the universe and investigate dark energy, among other astrophysical phenomena.

science.title: Why couldn’t NASA save its 20-year-old Swift Space Telescope? Here’s what went wrong
science.summary: NASA has abandoned efforts to rescue the 20-year-old Swift space telescope after it encountered control issues. The agency's plans to stabilize the aging observatory were deemed unfeasible, leading to the decision to allow it to eventually re-enter Earth's atmosphere. The situation raises questions about the future of the Swift telescope and the challenges of maintaining aging space technology.

science.title: What did Jurassic insects sound like? AI helps recreate 165-million-year-old ultrasonic communication
science.summary: Scientists have utilized AI, lasers, and fossilized wings to recreate the sounds of insects from 165 million years ago, unveiling a complex soundscape from the Jurassic period. This research highlights the potential for advanced technology to reconstruct ancient communication methods, providing insights into the ecological dynamics of that era. The findings contribute to understanding prehistoric life and its auditory environment.

entertainment.title: 'Toxic' movie review: Yash and Geetu Mohandas' clash of visions is an ambitious misfire
entertainment.summary: Geetu Mohandas' film "Toxic" attempts to merge her ambitious vision with Yash's star power but ultimately falls short. The clash of their differing styles results in a film that prioritizes visual excess over narrative coherence. Critics note that the balance expected from their collaboration is not achieved, leading to a cinematic experience that feels disjointed and unsatisfying.

entertainment.title: Remembering Dolly Parton, who gave away everything but her songs
entertainment.summary: Dolly Parton, renowned as the Queen of Country music, passed away on August 25, 2026. In 1974, the night before Elvis Presley was set to record "I Will Always Love You," his manager, Colonel Tom Parker, imposed a condition for the recording. Parton's legacy includes her philanthropic efforts, while her songs remain her own.

entertainment.title: Irumudi India Box Office Collections: Ravi Teja starrer maintains strong hold on Tuesday, grosses Rs 87 crore in 5 days
entertainment.summary: Ravi Teja's film Irumudi has performed well at the box office, grossing Rs 87 crore in five days. On Tuesday, it collected Rs 14.50 crore, reflecting a 10 percent decrease from Monday. The film's drop from its opening day was only 15 percent, indicating strong audience retention. Irumudi is anticipated to continue its successful run against competing films.
